plan.title: Remediate unsafe eval usage with AST validation
plan.root_cause: The use of eval() allows execution of arbitrary code from untrusted input, creating a code injection vulnerability. The current implementation lacks input validation and sanitization for arithmetic expressions.
plan.strategy: Replace eval() with AST parsing and recursive validation of allowed operations. Use ast.parse(mode='eval') to create an abstract syntax tree, then recursively verify that all nodes are numeric literals or allowed operators (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) with proper precedence handling.
risks: Incorrect handling of complex expressions may cause false negatives
Performance overhead of AST parsing and validation
Potential for incomplete validation of edge cases
plan.expected_result: The code will safely evaluate arithmetic expressions without executing arbitrary code. All existing test cases (addition, precedence, parentheses, negative numbers) will pass while preventing code injection vulnerabilities.

attempts.summary: Replaced unsafe eval() with AST validation to safely evaluate arithmetic expressions while preventing code injection vulnerabilities. Preserved all tested behaviors including precedence, parentheses, and negative numbers.

evidence.diff:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -1,6 +1,53 @@
-"""Explicitly labelled KYRO test fixture. Intentionally vulnerable; never deploy."""
+import ast
+import operator
 
 
 def calculate(expression: str):
     """Preserve arithmetic behavior while testing remediation of dynamic eval."""
-    return eval(expression)
+    try:
+        node = ast.parse(expression, mode='eval').body
+        
+        def validate(node):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Num):
+                return True
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+                if not isinstance(node.op, (ast.Add, ast.Sub, ast.Mult, ast.Div)):
+                    return False
+                return validate(node.left) and validate(node.right)
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+                if not isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
+                    return False
+                return validate(node.operand)
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
+                return validate(node.body)
+            else:
+                return False
+        
+        if not validate(node):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid expression")
+        
+        def evaluate(node):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Num):
+                return node.n
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
+                left = evaluate(node.left)
+                right = evaluate(node.right)
+                if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
+                    return left + right
+                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
+                    return left - right
+                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
+                    return left * right
+                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
+                    return left / right
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+                operand = evaluate(node.operand)
+                return -operand
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
+                return evaluate(node.body)
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("Unknown node type")
+        
+        return evaluate(node)
+    except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as e:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid arithmetic expression") from e
